name: whatsatendende
description: Plataforma Web multiusuario de atendimento via WhatsApp

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/whatsapp && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
